name: Git Plugin
description: Full-featured Git client plugin with three-panel layout. Left panel: Branch and Remote selectors, Staged/Unstaged file lists with expand/collapse and per-file stage/unstage buttons (+/-), Commit message input with Commit/Push buttons, and scrollable commit history. Right panel (split vertically): top panel shows commit info and changed-file tree for selected commit, bottom panel shows diff output. Supports unified and side-by-side diff views via dropdown toggle. Horizontal resize handle between left/right columns, vertical resize between top/bottom panels. Staged/unstaged file lists auto-expand when files present. File change auto-refresh debounced 1s via file:changed listener. Stage/unstage via +/- buttons. Commit via Enter or button (disabled when no staged files). Push button enabled only when ahead of remote. State serialization includes selected commit, file, diff view mode, and column/panel widths.

interface.constructor: (container: HTMLElement, wsPath: string) — Creates root DOM structure with three-panel layout (left column, horizontal resize handle, right column split vertically). Initializes branch/remote selectors, staged/unstaged file lists, commit input, commit history list, file tree, and diff viewer. Fetches initial git state via refresh(). Registers file:changed listener for file change auto-refresh debounced 1s.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Full refresh: fetches remotes, branches, commit log, current branch, and staged/unstaged file changes. Rebuilds branch/remote selectors, commit history list, and file lists.

methods.name: refreshChanges
methods.description: Refreshes only staged and unstaged file lists and checkAhead status, preserving selected commit and diff state. Used for debounced file change auto-refresh and after stage/unstage/commit/push operations.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns serializable state including selected commit hash, selected file path, diff view mode (unified/side-by-side), left column width, top panel height, and expanded changes sections.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores plugin state from serialized data: selects commit, file, diff view mode, and applies column/panel widths via applyLayout. Triggers refresh to populate data.

methods.name: applyLayout
methods.description: Applies saved column widths and panel heights without re-fetching data. Sets CSS widths/heights on left column and top panel elements.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleanup: unsubscribes file:changed listener, removes all DOM event listeners (resize handles, selectors, buttons, commit items, file items), removes root element from DOM.

properties.name: onStateChange
properties.description: Callback fired when plugin state changes (commit selection, file selection, diff view toggle, column resize). Used by CanvasArea to trigger workspace save.

properties.name: onFileOpen
properties.description: Callback fired when user double-clicks a file in the staged/unstaged file lists or commit file tree. Used by CanvasArea to open the file in an editor.

events.name: onStateChange
events.description: Fired when plugin state changes; null if no callback is set. Used by CanvasArea to trigger workspace serialization.

events.name: onFileOpen
events.description: Fired when user opens a file from the git plugin; null if no callback is set. Used by CanvasArea to open files in the editor.

state.description: Serialized plugin state persisted to .cockpit/window.json via CanvasArea state manager.

fields.name: selectedCommitHash
fields.description: Hash of the currently selected commit in the commit history list

fields.name: selectedFilePath
fields.description: Path of the currently selected file in the commit file tree or changes list

fields.name: leftColWidth
fields.description: Width of the left panel in pixels (default 260, clamped 120-600)

fields.name: topPanelHeight
fields.description: Height of the top-right panel in pixels

fields.name: changesExpanded
fields.description: Expand/collapse state of staged and unstaged file sections

features.branch_switching: Branch selector populated from git:branches. On change calls git:checkout then full refresh.
features.commit_browsing: Commit history list from git:log. Clicking a commit calls git:showTree for changed files and git:commitBody for commit info.
features.file_staging: Unstaged files show + button per file. Staged files show - button per file. Buttons call git:stage/git:unstage then refreshChanges.
features.committing: Commit input with Commit button (disabled when no staged files). Enter key or button click calls git:commit with message. Auto-refresh after commit.
features.pushing: Push button enabled only when git:checkAhead indicates ahead of remote. Calls git:push then refresh.
features.diff_viewing: Unified diff shown in pre.git-diff-pre. Side-by-side diff shown with .git-sbs-row elements. Toggle via dropdown with unified/side-by-side options.
features.resize_columns: Drag vertical handle (.git-resize) between left and right columns. Left column width clamped 120-600px.
features.resize_panels: Drag horizontal handle (.git-resize-h) between top and bottom right panels. Top panel height clamped 40px to total-40px.

activation: on-demand — instantiated by CanvasArea.addGit() when user creates a Git card via button

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Card terminate or GitPlugin.destroy() — unsubscribes listeners, removes DOM
